Reformate gas can be obtained by [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]], [[irradiating|Radiolysis Chamber]], [[breeding|Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]], [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] and multiple other methods. Its primary uses include the production of [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] and [[welding|Arc Welder]] [[cast combine steel plates|Combine Steel]].
